FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 450
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Kerry (Bubba)
Underwood
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/31/2025
House Bill 450 as introduced would increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid
from the State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30,
2027.
